title: Topic 14: Work & Study - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Talk about your job or studies

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. You, at work or at school.
Say 4 things:
1. Your job or study: I am a/an... (student? teacher?
your real job - ask your teacher for your job word!)
2. Where + when: I work/study in/at... in the morning /
at night (T7-8)
3. TWO things you can do: I can speak... I can write...
I can help...
4. One person in your family: his/her job with -s
(My mother works...)

Tip: Your real job word is YOUR word - learn it well!

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic14_work_study.txt, Lesson 14.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.
